limitations: The benchmark is a short single-process local SQLite/WAL baseline with deterministic arrivals and a small read handler, not production traffic.

The auditor role is adversarial and process-separated but not an external human or independently operated model; see docs/RESEARCH_STAGE_1_TICKETS.md for the explicit decision and S1-020 lift condition.
The 20 ms p95 value remains an internal target; no production SLO or customer commitment is authorized.
